newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: CALL FOR DAM ON ZIMBABWE-SAFRICAN LIMPOPO BORDER.
newsitem.headline: CALL FOR DAM ON ZIMBABWE-SAFRICAN LIMPOPO BORDER.

text.p: The chief executive of Zimbabwe's Beitbridge district has called on Zimbabwe and South Africa to build a dam on their Limpopo river border to help boost irrigation farming around the dry, drought-prone area.
Aaron Maboyi Ncube said peasants on either side of the river were turning out poor harvests because rains were generally poor.

"The two governments should consider tapping the Limpopo River to benefit thousands of people living in their adjacent provinces sharing the same climate," he told Zimbabwe's official daily Herald newspaper.
He said a dam could see the establishment of vast sugar-cane and citrus estates, offering jobs to thousands both in Zimbabwe and South Africa.
The Herald said Ncube's dam proposal had the support of many people, including businessmen, in the two countries.
